title: The Egg That Hums
text: In a nest of melted gold, cooled into ripples, sits one egg the size of a barrel. It is warm to the touch, and it hums a low note you feel in your teeth. The hum gets louder when your fiercest fighter is near, as if it already knows them.

options.label: Your fiercest, the one it hums for, cracks it and drinks.

outcomes.text: Scales first, by evening. Then the hunger, then the fire.
It tastes of smoke and iron, and they come away stronger.
Something in it fights back on the way down.

options.label: Wrap it up and carry it out, carefully.

outcomes.text: It goes quiet in the dark of a pack, a warm weight against the spine. The scholars will pay for it.
Its mother wants it back. You hear her coming long before you see her.
It goes out like a coal in the rain. The gold around it is still gold.
Its mother heard. The sky goes dark with her.
